source_refs.note: Exercise 4.1, Question 2: bank deposit with compound interest (Hint); book p. 128, answers p. 303 (PDF 305)

blocks.prompt: 2 Let \(A\) denote the amount of money deposited in a bank at time \(t\), which grows over time with constant compound interest rate \(r > 0\). Construct a differential equation which represents the growth of amount over time. (Hint: The rate of change of amount with respect to time is proportional to amount itself.)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh model banane ka sawal hai: hint ke jumle ko equation mein badalna hai.
Diya kya hai? Bank mein raqam \(A\) jo time \(t\) ke saath constant compound interest rate \(r\) se barhti hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(A\) ke liye differential equation.
"\(A\) ka rate of change" \(\frac{dA}{dt}\) hai, aur "\(A\) ke proportional" ka matlab constant guna \(A\); yahan woh constant khud interest rate \(r\) hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: raqam \(A(t)\), constant compound interest rate \(r > 0\); \(A\) ke badalne ka rate \(A\) ke proportional hai.
Maloom karna: \(A\) ke liye differential equation.
Tareeqa: Example 1 wala growth model \(\frac{dP}{dt} = kP\), jis mein \(k = r\).

Proportionality likhiye
\[\dfrac{dA}{dt} \propto A\]
Kyun: compound interest mein munafa poori maujooda raqam par milta hai, sirf asal raqam par nahi. Is liye jitni bari raqam, utna zyada munafa, yani utni tez barhotri. Jaise Rs. 1 lakh par 10% munafa Rs. 10,000 hai magar Rs. 2 lakh par Rs. 20,000.

Constant daliye
\[\dfrac{dA}{dt} = rA\]
\[\dfrac{dA}{dt} - rA = 0\]
Kyun: yahan constant of proportionality interest rate \(r\) hi hai; \(r > 0\) hai is liye raqam barhti hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\propto\) ka nishan final jawab mein nahi rehna chahiye.

Tasdeeq:
\(A = A_{0}e^{rt}\) se \(\frac{dA}{dt} = rA_{0}e^{rt} = rA\) (sympy se check kiya): raqam barhti hai, jaise bank mein barhni chahiye. Answer key \(\frac{dA}{dt} - rA = 0\) deti hai; jawab milta hai.
